## Problem description

This puzzle, published by Mickaël Launay [@lemonde2026génération], reads as follows:

>Exactly one year ago, on my birthday, I noticed that reversing the two digits of my age gave me my father’s age. 
>And today, precisely one year later, I realize that reversing the two digits of my age now gives me my daughter’s age. 
>What’s more, the age gap between my father and me is the same as the gap between me and my daughter.

The problem is to determine the ages of the father, the daughter, and the grandfather.

## MIP model

In this model, no logical reasoning is derived from the conditions. 

#### Variables

- $\textcolor{blue}{D} \in \mathbb{N}$: daughter's age
- $\textcolor{blue}{F} \in \mathbb{N}$: father's age
- $\textcolor{blue}{x}_F \in \{0,\dots,9\}$: first digit of $\textcolor{blue}{F}$
- $\textcolor{blue}{y}_F \in \{0,\dots,9\}$: second digit of $\textcolor{blue}{F}$
- $\textcolor{blue}{F}_{-1} \in \mathbb{N}$: father's age one year ago
- $\textcolor{blue}{x}_{F_{-1}} \in \{0,\dots,9\}$: first digit of $\textcolor{blue}{F}_{-1}$
- $\textcolor{blue}{y}_{F_{-1}} \in \{0,\dots,9\}$: second digit of $\textcolor{blue}{F}_{-1}$
- $\textcolor{blue}{GF} \in \mathbb{N}$: grandfather's age
- $\textcolor{blue}{GF}_{-1} \in \mathbb{N}$: grandfather's age one year ago


#### Objective function

As this is a feasibility problem, any dummy objective function is suitable:

$$
\min 0
$$

subject to:

#### Constraints

- Definition of father's age:

$$
\textcolor{blue}{F} = 10\textcolor{blue}{y}_F + \textcolor{blue}{x}_F
$$

- Definition of father's age one year ago:

\begin{align*}
\textcolor{blue}{F}_{-1} &= 10\textcolor{blue}{y}_{F_{-1}} + \textcolor{blue}{x}_{F_{-1}} \\
\textcolor{blue}{F}_{-1} &= \textcolor{blue}{F} -1
\end{align*}

- Definition of daughter's age (reverse digits):

$$
\textcolor{blue}{D} = 10\textcolor{blue}{x}_F + \textcolor{blue}{y}_F
$$

- Definition of grandfather's age one year ago (reverse digits and subtract $1$):

\begin{align*}
\textcolor{blue}{GF}_{-1} &= 10\textcolor{blue}{x}_{F_{-1}} + \textcolor{blue}{y}_{F_{-1}} \\
\textcolor{blue}{GF}_{-1} &= \textcolor{blue}{GF}-1
\end{align*}

- The age gap is constant:

$$
\textcolor{blue}{GF}-\textcolor{blue}{F}=\textcolor{blue}{F}-\textcolor{blue}{D}
$$
